issues: This printed CLI requires comparing TWO complete independently calculated natal charts, not a single-person first/eleventh-house friend count, profession or relative social rank prediction.

Original printed CLI body runs PDF671 lower through PDF673 upper, where a separate UNNUMBERED twelfth-house Enemies introduction begins after divider. Following printed CLIII on Enemies begins PDF674 without a separately observed CLII in studied pages.
The natural 'friend/enemy' lists of planets are source-attributed and explicitly ASYMMETRIC: Mars calls Venus its friend but Venus does not reciprocate. A symmetric matrix would distort the source.

Other printed planetary/nodal friendship rows use old glyphs, including a condensed lunar-node row with unresolved negative-group membership. Retain uncertainty; do not invent a complete authoritative friend graph.

The four enumerated source modes of Ascendant-lord concord are same ruler, received by house/exaltation, conjunction, or sextile/trine. Failure of all is said to imply brief friendship, not necessarily lack of initial affection.
Other alternate path uses interchange of Lights/Fortunes and planets occupying one another's natal places, with contradictory source strength and pejorative moral explanations.

The text distinguishes mutual agreement, practical utility, pleasure, exclusive attachment, inconstant friendship, competitive rivalry, and a later separate question of which party feels more affection. None are synonyms.

Several source phrases label people wicked, greedy, injurious or morally bad when malefics exchange positions or oppose. No actual person intent, crime, danger, abuse propensity or moral character can be inferred.
The old most-sincere-friend test uses each Ascendant ruler and benefic/malefic occupants and a directional sinister sextile/trine; A-loves-B and B-loves-A are not symmetric.
The final categorical claim about one person's Ascendant falling in the other's sixth/eighth/twelfth has no independently observed dyads or causal proof.
Source exact orbs, house geometry, zodiac choice, planetary reception and old aspect operator semantics are not fully executable or source-cross-collated.
No preregistered paired human charts, actual relationship history, outcome ages/durations, partner agreement measures, conflict records or matched baseline evaluated.
The following unnumbered twelfth-house source concerns enemies and adversaries, separate from two-way CLI and following printed CLIII on quality of enemies.
This is a photo-anchored historical paraphrase and reversible source map, not a full diplomatic seventeenth-century transcription or empirically validated compatibility scorer.
